name: CLI — /Hermes status
mechanical_verification: Execute /Hermes status, verify status text returned with session/agent/memory info

verification_steps.expected: Status output text mentioning agents, memory, or session info
verification_steps.mechanical_pass: Output is a non-empty string containing 'status' or agent/memory info

pass_criteria.returns_text: Output is a non-empty string (not an error)
pass_criteria.mentions_hermes: Output references Hermes or its components
pass_criteria.no_vanilla_response: Output is NOT a vanilla plan/build agent response

failure_modes.vanilla_response: Returns plan/build agent generic response instead

spillover_check.description: Vanilla agent must NOT respond to /Hermes status
spillover_check.test: As a plan agent, type /Hermes status
spillover_check.expected: Plan agent should ignore /Hermes, not respond with Hermes output
